response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing, my friends. Something's missing.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER JACK, approaches the king.

JESTER JACK
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I don't know, Jack. I just feel like our kingdom's aesthetic is, well, a bit...stale.

JESTER JACK
Stale, Your Majesty? But our kingdom is the epitome of grandeur!

KING REGINALD
Grandeur, yes, but also...tired. Like a worn-out tapestry. I want something new, something fresh.

JESTER JACK
I see what you mean, Your Majesty. Perhaps a bit of...futurism?

KING REGINALD
Futurism? Ha! I want something more...vintage. Like a dusty old vinyl record.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king summons his trusted advisor, LORD THOMAS. LORD THOMAS enters, bowing low.

LORD THOMAS
Your Majesty, what can I do for you?

KING REGINALD
I want to modernize our kingdom's aesthetic, Thomas. I want it to be...vaporwave.

LORD THOMAS
(stunned)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty? But that's...that's not exactly...medieval.

KING REGINALD
Nonsense, Thomas! I've seen the pictures. The pastel colors, the distorted images, the...the... (he searches for the right word)...the "wet" textures.

LORD THOMAS
(skeptical)
I see, Your Majesty. And what makes you think this...vaporwave aesthetic will appeal to our subjects?

KING REGINALD
Because, Thomas, our subjects are tired of the same old knights and castles. They want something new, something...futuristic.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The knights now wear neon-colored armor, the merchants peddle retro-futuristic gadgets, and the peasants...well, the peasants still look a bit bewildered.

KING REGINALD
(to the camera)
And so, my friends, our kingdom is reborn. We are no longer just a medieval empire, but a...a... (he searches for the right word)...a proto-vaporwave utopia.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king sits on his throne, surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in the most outlandish, futuristic attire.

KING REGINALD
(to his courtiers)
Now, let us celebrate our new aesthetic! Let us feast and dance and...and... (he searches for the right word)...and "wet" our beards!

The courtiers cheer, and the camera zooms out to reveal the kingdom in all its...vaporwave glory.

FADE TO BLACK.
